notes.title: V0.8.8 Important Controls Patch FIX
notes.notes: Unfortunately when we published the new version V0.8.8 yesterday, a new bug was introduced for any players downloading the game for the first time - causing the default keybinds to be all undefined, and the player unable to shoot. We have fixed this now with this update - apologies to all 3 of the new players who were affected Lol.
